name: Sumeet Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Sumeet Industries Ltd manufactures Polyester Chips and Polyester Yarns.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL is in the business of manufacturing and exporting Polyester Yarn (POY and FDY), Polyester Chips, Texturizing Yarn, and Carpet Yarn.

cons: Stock is trading at 7.98 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.25% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.179 Cr.
